'''FK Rad''' ({{Lang-sr-Cyrl|ФК Рад}}) is a [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Banjica]], [[Belgrade]], [[Serbia]]. They compete in the [[Belgrade Zone League]], the fourth tier of the [[Serbian football league system|national league system]]. It plays it home games at the [[King Peter I Stadium]].

Founded in 1958, the club spent a total of 30 seasons in the top flight between [[1987–88 Yugoslav First League|1987]] and [[2020–21 Serbian SuperLiga|2021]], including five seasons in the [[Yugoslav First League]], 12 seasons in the [[First League of Serbia and Montenegro]], and 13 seasons in the [[Serbian SuperLiga]]."}}
